core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nijat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Salvation, deliverance”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nijat corresponds to the Arabic form نَجَاة (Arabic root ن ج و (n-j-w); نَجَاة (Najāh)). Its core sense is nijat; salvation, deliverance. Nijat is Arabic نَجَاة (Najāh) 'salvation, deliverance', from the root ن ج و (n-j-w). The source gloss 'Deliverance, Salvation' is consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly male. Same name as nejat.
